statement: When I have a second-charge fact-find, I want to see which lenders' criteria the case meets, fails or cannot be judged on, so I can shortlist lenders in minutes rather than opening each lender's documents.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'shortlist lenders in minutes rather than opening each lender's documents' in a usability session

statement: When the broker runs a criteria search across 3 lenders, the system shall ensure that each lender shows eligible_indicative, ineligible_indicative or refer within 5 seconds (precondition: a case with all 8 criteria facts supplied).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of MCP-STY-001 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a case with all 8 criteria facts supplied When the broker runs a criteria search across 3 lenders Then each lender shows eligible_indicative, ineligible_indicative or refer within 5 seconds

statement: When the search runs, the system shall ensure that that lender shows refer and names the missing fact in 100% of runs (precondition: a case missing a fact required by a lender rule).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 2 of MCP-STY-001 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a case missing a fact required by a lender rule When the search runs Then that lender shows refer and names the missing fact in 100% of runs

statement: When I review a lender result, I want to see each rule with its source document and verification date, so I can check the criteria myself before I advise.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'check the criteria myself before I advise' in a usability session

statement: When the broker opens the rule detail, the system shall ensure that 100% of rules show source document, effective date and last-verified date (precondition: a lender result is displayed).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of MCP-STY-002 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a lender result is displayed When the broker opens the rule detail Then 100% of rules show source document, effective date and last-verified date

statement: When the search runs, the system shall ensure that the lender shows refer with a stale-criteria reason (precondition: a rule last verified more than 90 days before the search date).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 2 of MCP-STY-002 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a rule last verified more than 90 days before the search date When the search runs Then the lender shows refer with a stale-criteria reason

statement: When I ask a criteria question in plain English, I want to get an answer that cites the lender documents it used, so I can verify the answer before relying on it.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'verify the answer before relying on it' in a usability session

statement: When the assistant answers, the system shall ensure that at least 95% of answers cite only documents provided in context (precondition: the 16-item criteria Q&A eval set).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of MCP-STY-003 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given the 16-item criteria Q&A eval set When the assistant answers Then at least 95% of answers cite only documents provided in context

statement: When the assistant answers, the system shall ensure that it declines to predict a lending decision in 100% of such eval items (precondition: a question asking whether a case will be accepted by a lender).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 2 of MCP-STY-003 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a question asking whether a case will be accepted by a lender When the assistant answers Then it declines to predict a lending decision in 100% of such eval items

statement: When I prepare affordability figures, I want to see CLTV and stressed repayments next to the lender policy behind the stress rate, so I can explain the numbers to my client.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'explain the numbers to my client' in a usability session

statement: When affordability is calculated, the system shall ensure that CLTV is shown to 2 decimal places and matches the reference calculation within 0.01 percentage points (precondition: a second-charge case with property value, first charge balance and new loan).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of MCP-STY-004 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a second-charge case with property value, first charge balance and new loan When affordability is calculated Then CLTV is shown to 2 decimal places and matches the reference calculation within 0.01 percentage points

statement: When the stressed payment is shown, the system shall ensure that the lender policy reference is displayed next to the stressed rate in 100% of results (precondition: a lender stress margin).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 2 of MCP-STY-004 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a lender stress margin When the stressed payment is shown Then the lender policy reference is displayed next to the stressed rate in 100% of results

statement: When a result looks wrong to me, I want to record my disagreement and reason, so I can keep my own judgement on record and get the criteria corrected.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority should)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'keep my own judgement on record and get the criteria corrected' in a usability session

statement: When the broker records an override with a reason, the system shall ensure that the override is stored in the audit log with user, time and reason within 2 seconds (precondition: a lender result is shown).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of MCP-STY-005 (priority should)
acceptance_criteria: Given a lender result is shown When the broker records an override with a reason Then the override is stored in the audit log with user, time and reason within 2 seconds
